## Context

Why this is needed. Link related ADRs and issues.

## Plan

How it should work: behaviour, data flow, examples. For a `research` issue: the question, the method and the timebox.

## Tasks

- [ ] …
- [ ] Tests (pure domain logic unit-tested; synthetic data only)
- [ ] Alembic migration, if the schema changes
- [ ] ADR, if this makes or changes a decision; docs, if behaviour changes

## Done when

A check anyone can run, e.g. a command and what it prints or shows. For a `research` issue: the answer is
recorded in an ADR or a research note.
